title: John Mack moves away from a physical explanation of abductions

tellings.quote: he was he became less convinced that this was a purely physical nuts andbolts phenomenon

plain: The psychiatrist John Mack, who studied people who said they had been abducted by aliens, is said to have moved over the years away from the idea that abductions were physical events. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies the psychedelic drug DMT and mentions the DMT researcher Rick Strassman in the same discussion, tells Michels that Mack 'became less convinced that this was a purely physical nuts and bolts phenomenon.' Gallimore gives no source, and brings it up as a hint that the experiences may happen in the mind or in some other realm.
